description: Create a snapshot image from a server's disk — the safe thing to do BEFORE a risky change. Snapshots are billed for the space they use. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/create_image.

type.description: snapshot (kept until deleted) or backup (uses a backup slot). Defaults to snapshot.
